svg.title: Drive broadcast as state propagation versus command propagation
svg.desc: Command model has a sender pushing instructions to a receiver. Broadcast model has shared ambient state that L1 signals update and L3 reads on demand. EVA uses broadcast.

g.text: how task agents coordinate · not EVA
decides when to issue an order
"like a chemical reaction in a heated flask"
structural consequence: drive state files are read-only from upstream layers.
L3 cannot "override" survival intensity. it can only read it and reason within its bias.
